components.name: Play Button
components.description: OSC hit: filled orange rectangle. Stays on the strip when empty, disabled.
components.css: .ds-btn-play { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; min-width: 96px; padding: 0 20px; background: var(--color-accent); color: var(--color-on-accent); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.25rem; border: none; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-play:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-play:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Header and sheet actions: Import, Search, Download, Connect.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; background: var(--color-secondary); color: var(--color-on-secondary); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.25rem; border: none; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-muted); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Skip and other tertiary text actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-muted-foreground); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.25rem; border: none; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--color-foreground); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Square muted well with hairline; orange focus outline.
components.css: .ds-input { min-height: 44px; width: 100%; padding: 0 12px; background: var(--color-muted); color: var(--color-foreground); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.25rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 0; caret-color: var(--color-accent); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Left Rail
components.description: Named destinations on deep bezel; current item gets a left orange hairline.
components.html: Miru
components.css: .ds-rail { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 11rem; min-height: 20rem; padding: 16px 0; background: var(--color-bezel); border-right: 1px solid var(--color-border); font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-wordmark { margin: 0 20px 20px; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.75rem; letter-spacing: -0.025em; color: var(--color-foreground); } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; width: 100%; padding: 0 12px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-muted-foreground); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.25rem; text-align: left; border: none; border-left: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms, color 200ms; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--color-muted); color: var(--color-foreground); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-item-current { background: var(--color-muted); color: var(--color-foreground); border-left-color: var(--color-accent); } .ds-nav-settings { margin-top: auto; }

components.name: Sheet
components.description: Square inset panel for match, forms, and inherited list blocks.
components.html:
Match AniList title

Show title stays secondary copy.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--color-card); color: var(--color-foreground); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 0; padding: 16px; font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.5rem; } .ds-card-meta { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.25rem; color: var(--color-muted-foreground); }

components.name: Poster Tile
components.description: Square cover in the Library field. Selected: orange outline. No Play on the tile.
components.css: .ds-poster { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 8.5rem; padding: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--color-foreground); text-align: left; border: none; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-poster-current { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-poster:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-poster-art { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; width: 100%; padding: 8px; background: var(--color-muted); color: var(--color-muted-foreground); font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1rem; } .ds-poster-title { margin-top: 8px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.25rem; } .ds-poster-meta { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1rem; color: var(--color-muted-foreground); }

components.name: OSC Strip
components.description: Locked Library playback bar: filename, episode ticks, rectangular Play.
components.html: show.mkv
components.css: .ds-osc { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; background: var(--color-bezel); border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border); color: var(--color-foreground); font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-osc-progress { position: absolute; top: 0; right: 0; left: 0; height: 2px; background: var(--color-muted); pointer-events: none; } .ds-osc-progress-fill { display: block; width: 36%; height: 100%; background: var(--color-accent); } .ds-osc-file { flex: 0 0 auto; max-width: 28%; margin: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.25rem; } .ds-osc-ticks { position: relative; flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; } .ds-osc-line { position: absolute; right: 0; left: 0; top: 50%; height: 1px; background: var(--color-border); pointer-events: none; } .ds-osc-tick { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; min-width: 12px; padding: 0; background: transparent; border: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-osc-tick:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-osc-tick-mark { display: block; width: 2px; height: 12px; background: var(--color-muted-foreground); } .ds-osc-tick-mark-current { height: 16px; background: var(--color-accent); } .ds-osc .ds-btn-play { flex-shrink: 0; }

narrative.overview:
Miru is a player bezel, not a storefront. The field is matte black; chrome (the left rail and the bottom OSC) sits one step darker. Type is pale phosphor. The only loud color is OSC orange, used as the hit: Play, progress, the selected mark. Every control is a rectangle. One workhorse sans carries titles, rows, and labels.

Library is the signature surface: square posters fill the field; selecting a show locks a bottom OSC with a hairline episode timeline and a rectangular Play. Import and AniList match stay on the sheet above that strip. Other destinations inherit the same tokens, bezel rail, zero-radius chrome, and type — not the OSC composition.

Confirmed visual rejection: a streaming-app card grid with rounded tiles and a Play on every row.
keyCharacteristics: Matte field with darker bezel chrome
Single orange hit (Play, progress, selected marks)
One sans: Source Sans 3 Variable, self-hosted
Hairline rules and tonal stacking; no shadows
Named left rail; Settings docked at the bottom

rules.name: The Play Hit Rule
rules.body: Orange is the hit: Play, progress, the current tick, the selected poster outline, the current rail mark. Do not fill chrome, sheets, or poster tiles with it.

rules.name: The Bezel Stack Rule
rules.body: Rail and OSC sit on deep bezel; the field is one step lighter; sheets sit one step lighter than the field. Depth is this stack, not a shadow.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Source Sans 3 Variable is the only family. No second sans, no display serif, no monospace as a voice.

rules.name: The Field-and-Rail Rule
rules.body: Named destinations live in the rail. The field is the work. Do not add a top app bar.

rules.name: The Flat Bezel Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest and in motion. No drop shadow, no glow, no blur.

rules.name: The Zero Radius Rule
rules.body: Controls, posters, sheets, inputs, and notices are square. Do not introduce a radius scale.

dos: Do keep Play as a filled orange rectangle on the OSC, including the empty state (disabled, not swapped for Import).
Do browse by square posters; put episode choice and Play on the OSC.
Do park Import and AniList match in the header / sheet, never in front of Play.
Do mark the current rail destination with a left orange hairline on a muted fill.
Do paint playback and download progress as orange fills on muted tracks.
Do keep every corner at 0px and every primary control at least 44px tall.
donts: Don't put a Play control on every poster or every row.
Don't round posters, Play, sheets, or inputs into pills or cards with radius.
Don't fill chrome, nav, or poster tiles with orange.
Don't introduce a second type family or a display face.
Don't add drop shadows, blurs, or lifted cards.
Don't add a top app bar; destinations stay in the named left rail.
